title: Anyone been to my dreamworld?
content: I live in the Bay Area and it seems to be a reflection of that. I go on this highway that looks kind of like the Bay Bridge to get there. There’s a plaza sort of mall, it’s not round but a straight block down. There’s a big supermarket, looks like the Maxi Pali in Santa Cruz, Costa Rica (I lived there for half my life), and a few thrift stores. A few dreams ago I stopped by this clothing rack with a Harley Davidson t-shirt and went back last night to find it. I live in this half abandoned/in construction half done house.. with some white girls who I’ve never met that are my “sisters”? (I don’t have any siblings). Sometimes it looks like the summer camp I went too but a spa, i’m thinking the house is based off of the cabins we would stay in and my sisters are the girls I would stay with during camp. My elementary, middle and high school are all there but weirder, darker and all mushed together. I’ve been seeing visiting my ex boyfriend at school in every single dream i’ve had. Sometimes i’m alone, usually I’m with my dad, ex boyfriend or best friend. I’ve never gotten a nightmare, sometimes there’s a creepy/bad vibe but mainly i’m just doing day to day things. I never smoke in my dreams though, which is weird cause i’m vaping/smoking weed 24/7, and i never use my phone in my dreams either. I’d love for someone to tell my what’s going on if they’ve read to this point.
